content: If development error detection for TtcanIf is enabled: The function CanIf_TTGetSyncQuality() shall raise the error CAN_E_PARAM_- POINTER and shall return E_NOT_OK if one of the parameter CanIf_ClockSpeed and CanIf_GlobalTimePhase is a NULL pointer.
